summary: 新稿已修正超声/OCT混写、按破口统一治疗、糖尿病出血机制错绑、笼统气泡警示和把食谱缺失说成疗效定论。剩余四组最小修订为用药风险深度、部分定位绑定、非裂孔性治疗交叉支持和特异预防行动支持。本报告不把普通解释、行政求助或已验证风险的具体场景机械变成双源缺口。

bilingual_check.assessment: 逐项读取当前中英文本；急诊动作、气泡条件及术后恶化条件对应。全文没有新剂量计算或统一禁食时数。

source_independence.rule: Different independently authored institutions can share NHS affiliation; that alone is not republication. NEI pages remain one group, ASRS pages remain one group. Same-author pages do not produce another independent writer.
shared_upstream: Mayo explicitly cites NEI, ASRS and AAO plus textbooks.
Cleveland explicitly cites NEI, ASRS, AAO and StatPearls.
MSD cites AAO 2020 PPP. ASRS diabetes guideline cites ADA and shared trials.
source_independence.interpretation: Independent editorial corroboration is not independent experimental replication; no trial count or certainty upgrade is inferred.

findings.issue: 用药节解释了术后眼药的用途和使用纪律，但没有区分常用类别，也未说明关键药物风险。
findings.required_change: 用简短中文/英文解释抗炎激素眼药与抗感染药的不同作用；补充实际适用时的眼压升高、感染被掩盖或加重等关键风险，以及为何需要眼科复查。可用本报告新读的 NHS 地塞米松资料与英国 SmPC 交叉支持；不把英国某一制剂的剂量、批准人群或疗程套用到所有地区。保留恶化时联系医院的动作。

findings.issue: 部分复合句已有可用原文，但绑定页面或定位没有覆盖该分句。
findings.required_change: 按各 claim 的 assessment 修正已存在来源的精确定位；红眼警讯注明共用术后情境，气泡页不能带入黄斑裂孔疗效或固定头位。这个问题主要是证据绑定，不等于正文医学事实错误。

findings.issue: 渗出性炎症相关治疗本次仅由 MSD 实际确认；不能把病因介绍当作第二份治疗支持。
findings.required_change: 补一份实际读取、独立编写且支持该治疗适用范围的专业材料，或收窄相应句子并如实保留单源缺口。不能为了通过删除非裂孔性病种的知识责任。

findings.issue: 护目装备与风险相关复查的现有第二来源 EyeWiki 未能在本次复核中读到正文。
findings.required_change: 对确实保留的预防行动补可读取的独立支持，或只保留有直接支持的范围并继续标记单源；不要求凭空增加检查频率或儿童/孕妇统一规则。

prior_findings_disposition.R01: Fixed the unsupported routine complication checklist by narrowing text; redness component binding still RR02.
prior_findings_disposition.R02: Resolved: ultrasound and OCT purposes separated.
prior_findings_disposition.R03: Mechanism scope corrected; second-source therapy gap remains RR03.
prior_findings_disposition.R04: Core gas hazard resolved with RCOphth and Moorfields. Dental/ambulance are bounded contexts of same verified hazard.
prior_findings_disposition.R05: Claim types now identify key actions/risks. Ordinary explanations do not require two writers automatically.
prior_findings_disposition.R06: Stable-floater and dilation clauses supported. Acute transport has direct NHS regional support, accurately single-source.
prior_findings_disposition.R07: Resolved: NEI diabetic symptoms, not traction locator, supports vitreous bleeding.
prior_findings_disposition.R08: Concrete hygiene and no-sharing source passages available; assistance request is low-risk coordination. Drug-risk depth remains RR01.
prior_findings_disposition.R09: Bounded perioperative coordination supported; no fixed fasting time or unsupported dietary efficacy claim.
prior_findings_disposition.R10: Diabetes systemic care and PVR now have independent support; specific preventive-action gap remains RR04.
prior_findings_disposition.R11: Recovery limits supported. Component locators for prognosis factors need RR02 correction.
prior_findings_disposition.R12: Resolved by narrower symptom and source-scope language.
